about: Ask the Department of Health to approve medical treatment abroad for a patient.
note: Requirements read from the official Department of Health Abu Dhabi FAQ page on the checked date. Details are filled in after sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: A patient may have up to 2 official escorts aged 18 or over
An escort must be a UAE national, or a relative up to the third degree if not
Escorts need international health insurance before tickets are issued, except Thiqa 1 holders
documents: Medical report not older than 3 months
timing: Approval time depends on the medical evaluation and any extra requirements of the centre
channels: TAMM website or app, or a TAMM service centre
International Patient Care Centre: tel 02 4493333, WhatsApp 02 4193399
